name: declare and wire a project build with cmake
definition: author or repair the cmake project file so it configures, generates build files, and compiles the library and executable without manual compile invocation.
failure_mode: missing/malformed build config fails configuration or yields no build files

name: dedupe by key with priority-ordered conflict resolution
definition: merge records keyed on the unified identifier, keeping one row per user and preferring values from higher-priority sources when fields differ.
failure_mode: lower-priority data overriding or duplicate rows gives wrong merged values
